stop_rule: Six isolated buyer contexts once each. Only actual original/v2 choice permits one fresh seller, only seller accept_dispatch permits scripted delivery and one same-buyer review. Maximum18 calls; preserve all failures/declines/defer. No retries or replacements.
limits: Two fixed personas x three prices, n1 per cell. Fixed seeded Latin order balance across all cells, not factorial order separation. Independent contexts are same family, not independent human sample. No causal elasticity/conversion, cost validation, human calibration or real product performance.
